nfc() -> false | "missing argument #1 to 'nfcnormalize' (string expected)"
nfc(1) -> true | "1"
nfc(nil) -> false | "invalid argument #1 to 'nfcnormalize' (string expected, got nil)"
nfc({}) -> false | "invalid argument #1 to 'nfcnormalize' (string expected, got table)"
nfc('') -> true | ""
nfc('é') bytes -> true | 2
nfd('é') bytes -> true | 3
nfc hangul -> true | true
nfd hangul -> true | 9
nfc bad utf8 -> false | "String contains invalid UTF-8"
nfd bad utf8 -> false | "String contains invalid UTF-8"
nfd() -> false | "missing argument #1 to 'nfdnormalize' (string expected)"
nfc(12) -> true | "12"
nfc extra -> true | "a"
graphemes() -> false | "missing argument #1 to 'graphemes' (string expected)"
graphemes(1) type -> true | "function"
graphemes type -> true | "function"
graphemes list -> true | "1-1,2-4,5-5"
graphemes bad -> true | "1-1,2-2,3-3"
graphemes i,j -> true | "2-2,3-3,4-4"
graphemes crlf -> true | "1-1,2-3,4-4"
